description: This file contains a PHP class definition for managing tax classes within the OpenCart admin localisation controllers. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and saving tax class data, and handles HTTP request parameters, view rendering, and interaction with the model layer.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax classes in the OpenCart admin localisation section. Provides CRUD operations and listing functionality for tax classes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main list page of tax classes, handles sorting, pagination, and loading the list of tax classes.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of tax classes, sets up pagination and sorting, and renders the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the data for displaying the list of tax classes including sorting, ordering, pagination, and fetches data from the model.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a tax class, populating data if editing an existing record.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or edited tax class, performs validation, and returns JSON response.
